The '''DCM-8 Missile Platform Droid''' was designed by [[Arakyd Patrol]]. It moved around using tank-like magnetic treads and had twelve turret-mounted mini-[[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used a DCM-8 to defend [[Jatee]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EJ" />
